integrity: The all-parameter formula is justified by a self-contained algebraic proof plus an explicitly credited published resource lemma; the companion finite computations are supplementary and no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The finite graph is a six-neighbor rectangular-period triangular torus with both periods at least three.
The calculation is over the two-element field; other field characteristics or altered lattice identifications are not covered.
The ancillary interpretation uses the existing mixed-graph commuting-stabilizer extension definition.
Equivalence to differently indexed work in modular cellular automata cannot be completely excluded.
title: Binary rank and ancillary-qubit cost on triangular toroidal mixed graphs
